items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 25 May 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers the area and much of Europe, with low pressure near Iceland.


##Wind##

Variable 1 to 3, settling North or Northwest 3 or 4 tonight or tomorrow morning, occasionally 5 in the west of the area tomorrow afternoon and evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, becoming slight or moderate later tomorrow.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Veering East 4 or 5 in all waters overnight into Wednesday, then occasionally 6 in the south of the area on Wednesday morning. Increasing East or Southeast 5 or 6 on Wednesday evening, possibly occasionally 7 in the south and west of the area.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
